business_problem: OgCloud and the game publishers it serves needed a better acquisition model because traditional advertising was getting more expensive, ROI was lagging, and large game packages caused many players to drop before installation completed.
solution_summary: OgCloud and Baidu AI Cloud built a cloud-gaming acquisition stack to solve rising ad costs and user drop-off before large packages finish downloading. ARM-based IaaS services and the Cloud Gaming Solution provide the low-latency compute, resource scheduling, and unified save capabilities needed to stream playable sessions from the cloud, while Cloud Phone serves as the runtime behind OgCloud's products. On top of that base, Cloud Interactive Advertising lets users try a game instantly through interactive video before deciding whether to download or pay. The Cloud Microclient Acquisition Solution then splits large packages into roughly 20 MB or 100 MB trial clients, starts the remaining download silently during the experience, and keeps region or server selection and payment logic synchronized when players convert. Combined with Baidu's search and information-flow distribution, the architecture links instant trial, precise distribution, and full-install conversion in one pipeline.

solution_components.name: Cloud Interactive Advertising

solution_components.name: Cloud Microclient Acquisition Solution

data_flow: Game content runs on ARM-based cloud compute and the Cloud Gaming Solution, then reaches users through Cloud Interactive Advertising so they can play instantly over video streaming. If they continue, the Cloud Microclient Acquisition Solution downloads the remaining full package in the background while keeping region, server, and payment logic synchronized, and Baidu's search and information-flow channels provide precise traffic distribution into the funnel.
business_outcome: OgCloud made game-user acquisition easier and more precise, improved conversion and activation for publishers, reduced download abandonment for large titles, and created a reusable cloud-based acquisition model for head game distributors.
metrics: Microclient trial packages are about 20 MB or 100 MB.
architecture_clues: The cloud gaming layer provides low-latency video interaction, fine-grained resource scheduling, and unified game-save handling.
The full workflow keeps the game entity in the cloud, which helps with copyright and anti-piracy control.
Microclient and full-package flows synchronize region or server information and payment logic.
The experience depends on cloud processing plus a 5G network environment for instant play.

Cloud interactive advertising lets users try first and download later, which improves attraction, conversion, and retention (original: 云互动广告，先试玩再下载…大幅提升广告对于用户的吸引力，从而降低获客难度、提升获客规模，提升转化率与留存率).

OgCloud splits large packages into about 20M or 100M microclients and downloads the rest silently while keeping server and payment logic synchronized (original: 将大包体拆分生成20M或者100M左右小包…剩余安装包在体验过程中静默下载…解决了云微端包和完整包的区服信息，支付逻辑的同步问题).
